pullRequest.title: Verify approved Firestore Rules deployments
pullRequest.body:
The module-reopen repair needs changed Firestore Rules, but the prior backend verifier admits only Rules already matching source. Add a separately approved Rules-only successor path that proves the actual mutation and the subsequent strict live readback.

The proof binds exact source and completed main CI, immutable approval, prior/new Rules, unchanged indexes and field overrides, a clean command checkout, actual CLI output, and ordered observations. It also binds a completed locked clean installation: measured Node/npm and the full installed CLI tree must match fresh measurements immediately before and after the command. Scripts and global Node lookup are disabled, including in the actual Firebase readback child. A final tree comparison detects installed files changing during the later installer/source checks. Historical receipts remain verifiable offline from their retained evidence.

Validation: all five release-gate jobs passed in run 34747307256 at final head e80b40485d152715b9d43b1077f2a273e2505b25, including 334 release-verification tests; CodeQL passed in run 34747306046. Both review findings were reproduced, corrected and resolved. Local regressions include 59 affected authority cases, 42 collector measurement cases and the complete 13-case Rules collector suite, with actual local bytes and subprocess execution. The final timing correction received independent follow-up review. These counts overlap CI and are not additive.

Actual source-bound production measurements, an explicit deployment decision, execution and final readbacks remain required. Synthetic approval/command fixtures do not establish a real installation or deployment. This PR does not authorize deployment or produce a release APK.

head_commit.message:
Verify approved Firestore Rules deployments (#367)

* release: verify reviewed Rules-only deployment evidence

* Bind reviewed Rules deployment to measured installed runtime

* Disable global module lookup in Rules readback child

* Recheck installed CLI after remaining runtime observations
